```{r libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(sf)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(kableExtra)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(osmextract)
```

```{r}
subzone <- read_sf(here("data", "raw", "MasterPlan2019SubzoneBoundaryNoSeaGEOJSON.geojson"))

area_center <- c("PHILLIP", "RAFFLES PLACE", "BAYFRONT SUBZONE", "NICOLL", "ANSON", "TANJONG PAGAR", "MAXWELL", "CECIL", "CENTRAL SUBZONE", "BUGIS", "MARINA CENTRE", "CITY HALL")
area_jurong <- c("JURONG GATEWAY", "INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS PARK", "LAKESIDE (LEISURE)", "LAKESIDE (BUSINESS)" )
area_woodlands <- c("NORTH COAST", "WOODLANDS REGIONAL CENTRE")
area_tampines <- c("TAMPINES NORTH", "TAMPINES WEST", "TAMPINES EAST")
```

```{r}
hub_jurong <- subzone %>%
  filter(SUBZONE_N %in% area_jurong) %>% 
  select(-REGION_N, -REGION_C, -SUBZONE_NO)

hub_tampines <- subzone %>%
  filter(SUBZONE_N %in% area_tampines) %>% 
  select(-REGION_N, -REGION_C, -SUBZONE_NO)

hub_woodlands <- subzone %>%
  filter(SUBZONE_N %in% area_woodlands) %>% 
  select(-REGION_N, -REGION_C, -SUBZONE_NO)

hubs <- bind_rows(hub_jurong, hub_tampines, hub_woodlands)

hubs_4326 <- hubs %>% 
  st_transform(4326)

rm(hub_jurong, hub_tampines, hub_woodlands)
```

```{r}
jurong_sf <- hubs_4326 %>% 
  filter(PLN_AREA_N == "JURONG EAST") %>% 
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry))
jurong_bbox <- st_bbox(jurong_sf)

tampines_sf <- hubs_4326 %>% 
  filter(PLN_AREA_N == "TAMPINES") %>% 
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry))
tampines_bbox <- st_bbox(tampines_sf)

woodlands_sf <- hubs_4326 %>% 
  filter(PLN_AREA_N == "WOODLANDS") %>% 
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry))
woodlands_bbox <- st_bbox(woodlands_sf)
```

```{r}
interested_features <- list(
  "amenity" = c("bar", "biergarten", "pub", "restaurant", "cafe", "fast_food", 
                "food_court", "cinema", "theatre", "community_centre", "library", "nightclub"),
  "shop" = c("mall", "supermarket", "department_store"),
  "leisure" = c("park", "sports_centre", "fitness_centre", "playground")
)

jurong_raw <- opq(bbox = jurong_bbox) %>% 
  add_osm_features(features = interested_features) %>% 
  osmdata_sf()

poi_jurong <- jurong_raw$osm_points %>% 
  st_intersection(jurong_sf) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(amenity) | !is.na(shop) | !is.na(leisure)) %>%
  mutate(hub = "Jurong East")

Sys.sleep(2)

tampines_raw <- opq(bbox = tampines_bbox) %>% 
  add_osm_features(features = interested_features) %>% 
  osmdata_sf()

poi_tampines <- tampines_raw$osm_points %>% 
  st_intersection(tampines_sf) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(amenity) | !is.na(shop) | !is.na(leisure)) %>%
  mutate(hub = "Tampines")

woodlands_raw <- opq(bbox = woodlands_bbox) %>% 
  add_osm_features(features = interested_features) %>% 
  osmdata_sf()

poi_woodlands <- woodlands_raw$osm_points %>% 
  st_intersection(woodlands_sf) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(amenity) | !is.na(shop) | !is.na(leisure)) %>%
  mutate(hub = "Woodlands")
```

```{r}
poi_collection <- bind_rows(poi_jurong, poi_tampines, poi_woodlands)
rm(poi_jurong, poi_tampines, poi_woodlands)
```

```{r}
pois_classified <- poi_collection %>%
  mutate(
    poi_category = case_when(
      amenity %in% c("bar", "biergarten", "pub", "nightclub") ~ "Nightlife",
      amenity %in% c("restaurant", "cafe", "fast_food", "food_court") ~ "Dining",
      amenity %in% c("cinema", "theatre", "arts_centre") | 
        leisure %in% c("park", "sports_centre", "fitness_centre", "playground") ~ "Family_Leisure",
      shop %in% c("mall", "department_store", "clothes", "fashion", "shoes", "books", "electronics") ~ "Retail_Shopping",
      shop %in% c("supermarket", "convenience", "bakery", "butcher", "greengrocer") ~ "Daily_Needs",
      amenity %in% c("community_centre", "library") ~ "Community",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    ) %>% 
  filter(poi_category != "Other") %>% 
  select(poi_category, geometry, hub, name) %>% 
  arrange(poi_category)
```
